shared_elements: human figure in profile with raised arm(s)
winged/radiating motif above or behind figure
low relief carving of figures at large scale on a wall panel
offering/gesture toward something in front of the figure
registers or bands of smaller repeated signs/details
justification: Both show large low-relief human figures in profile with an arm raised in a ritual gesture, accompanied by radiating/feathered motifs and bands of small repeated signs. But the specific content differs sharply: A is a single monumental bearded winged figure filling the panel with wings springing from its own back and a bucket-like object in one hand, whereas B is a multi-figure scene with a rayed disc above, an altar table piled with offerings, and several attendant figures of varying size, arranged in registers with dense inscription blocks.
